segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to another lesson at EnglishPod.

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And I'm Catherine and today we're talking about shopping online.
segments.zh: 我是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是在线购物。

segments.en: So this is an elementary level lesson.
segments.zh: 所以这是一节初级课程。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: We are going to shop for things online.
segments.zh: 我们将在网上购买东西。

segments.zh: 好吧，我们今天看到的这个词是 ebay。

segments.en: eBay.

segments.en: Okay, so this is a proper noun.
segments.zh: 好的，所以这是一个专有名词。

segments.en: It's an actual website, ebay.com.
segments.zh: 这是一个实际的网站，ebay.com。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's kind of like a store on the internet for people who want to buy used things.
segments.zh: 对于想要购买二手东西的人来说，这有点像互联网上的商店。

segments.en: Okay, so maybe if you have a TV that you don't want anymore, you go on eBay, you put pictures of it online and you offer it and anyone can buy it.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许如果你有一台你不再想要的电视，你去 ebay，你把它的照片放在网上，你提供它，任何人都可以买到它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You can be a buyer, that means you buy things or a seller.
segments.zh: 你可以是买家，这意味着你买东西或卖家。

segments.en: So you sell things.
segments.zh: 所以你卖东西。

segments.en: So this is interesting.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣。

segments.en: Usually you find used things on eBay but you can also find new things.
segments.zh: 通常你在 eBay 上找到的是用过的东西，但也能找到新东西。

segments.en: You can.

segments.en: It's kind of like the Chinese website Taobao.
segments.zh: 有点像中文网站淘宝。

segments.en: I've actually even seen people selling cars on eBay.
segments.zh: 实际上，我甚至在 eBay 上看到人们卖汽车。

segments.en: Cars?

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I can't imagine buying a car on the internet.
segments.zh: 我无法想象在互联网上买车。

segments.en: Really?

segments.en: No, they have even very luxurious cars on eBay.
segments.zh: 不，他们甚至在 eBay 上都有非常豪华的汽车。

segments.zh: 我只是在 ebay 上寻找一个漂亮的枕头。

segments.en: That's absurd.
segments.zh: 太荒唐了。

segments.en: Why?

segments.en: I don't have to leave the house or browse a dozen stores to find what I'm looking for.
segments.zh: 我不必离开家或浏览十几家商店来找到我要找的东西。

segments.en: This way, I just search for it online quick and easy.

segments.en: I see.

segments.en: But how do you pay for it?

segments.en: Wow, that sounds pretty safe.
segments.zh: 哇，听起来很安全。

segments.en: So how do you pay?
segments.zh: 那么你如何付款？

segments.en: Do you need a credit card?

segments.en: You can use a credit card or your debit card.
segments.zh: 您可以使用信用卡或借记卡。

segments.en: They also let you use the PayPal system, which is really safe and fast.
segments.zh: 他们还允许您使用 PayPal 系统，该系统非常安全且快速。

segments.en: I have never had any problems with someone hacking my information or anything.
segments.zh: 我从来没有遇到过有人入侵我的信息或任何东西。

segments.en: Do you think I can find a sweater for my dog online?

segments.en: You can find anything.

segments.en: Are you sure you want to start shopping online though?

segments.en: Okay.

segments.en: And then when they were talking about eBay and how it works, the person mentioned that they have a point system.
segments.zh: 然后当他们谈论 eBay 以及它是如何工作的时，这个人提到他们有一个积分系统。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A point system.

segments.en: Now, this is something you hear about a lot on websites these days.
segments.zh: 现在，这是您这些天在网站上经常听到的内容。

segments.en: For example, many websites have different users.
segments.zh: 例如，许多网站有不同的用户。

segments.en: And so how do I know which users or which in this case, sellers are the best?
segments.zh: 那么我如何知道哪些用户，或者说在这种情况下哪些卖家是最好的？

segments.en: Well, we have a point system.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们有一个点系统。

segments.en: More points means better, fewer points means worse.
segments.zh: 更多的点意味着更好，更少的点意味着更糟。

segments.en: You might also call this a star system.
segments.zh: 你也可以称之为星级系统。

segments.en: So basically a point system is a way to show who is a very good community member and who is not.
segments.zh: 所以基本上一个积分系统是一种展示谁是一个非常好的社区成员，谁不是的方式。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And that takes us to our next word.
segments.zh: 这将我们带到了我们的下一个词。

segments.en: So if a person has a lot of points in their point system, that means they are trustworthy.
segments.zh: 因此，如果一个人在他们的积分系统中有很多积分，这意味着他们是值得信赖的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Trustworthy is an adjective.

segments.en: He is trustworthy.
segments.zh: 他是值得信赖的。

segments.en: They are trustworthy.
segments.zh: 他们是值得信赖的。

segments.en: This means that I can trust them.

segments.en: They are reliable.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So I don't think they will lie to me.

segments.en: I don't think they will cheat me.

segments.en: Okay.

segments.en: So a person can be trustworthy.

segments.en: Right.

segments.en: But how do you pay for it?
segments.zh: 但是你怎么付钱呢？

segments.en: How do you know you aren't going to be ripped off by the seller?
segments.zh: 你怎么知道卖家不会骗你的钱？

segments.en: Well, the website handles a point system where if the seller does something wrong, people comment negatively.
segments.zh: 好吧，该网站有一套积分系统，如果卖家做错了事，人们就会发表负面评论。

segments.en: And then you know that he or she may not be trustworthy.
segments.zh: 然后你知道他或她可能不值得信赖。

segments.en: Wow, that sounds pretty safe.
segments.zh: 哇，听起来很安全。

segments.en: So how do you pay?
segments.zh: 那么你如何付款？

segments.en: Do you need a credit card?
segments.zh: 你需要信用卡吗？

segments.en: You can use a credit card or your debit card.
segments.zh: 您可以使用信用卡或借记卡。

segments.en: They also let you use the PayPal system, which is really safe and fast.
segments.zh: 他们还允许您使用 PayPal 系统，该系统非常安全且快速。

segments.en: I have never had any problems with someone hacking my information or anything.
segments.zh: 我从来没有遇到过有人入侵我的信息或任何东西。

segments.en: Do you think I can find a sweater for my dog online?
segments.zh: 你认为我可以在网上为我的狗找到一件毛衣吗？

segments.en: You can find anything.
segments.zh: 什么都找得到。

segments.en: Are you sure you want to start shopping online though?
segments.zh: 您确定要开始在线购物吗？

segments.en: Once you step into this world, there is no turning back.
segments.zh: 一旦你踏入这个世界，就没有回头路了。

segments.en: Let's do it.
segments.zh: 我们开始吧。

segments.en: Alright so now talking about online shopping, have you ever bought anything online?
segments.zh: 好吧，现在说到网上购物，你有没有在网上买过东西？

segments.en: Use your credit card online.
segments.zh: 在线使用您的信用卡。

segments.en: I have.
segments.zh: 我有。

segments.en: I've used my credit card on Amazon.com to purchase books on the internet.
segments.zh: 我在 Amazon.com 上使用我的信用卡在互联网上购买书籍。

segments.en: But I know that you are much more of a fan of online shopping.
segments.zh: 但我知道你更喜欢网上购物。

segments.en: You use the Chinese website Taobao all the time.
segments.zh: 您一直使用中文网站淘宝。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well actually, I wrote this dialogue and it's kind of based on something real because you know sometimes going to the stores, it can be great and you can see things and physically touch them.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，我写了这个对话，它有点基于真实经历，因为你知道有时候去商店感觉不错，你能看到并亲手摸到那些东西。

segments.en: But I'm a little bit more practical.
segments.zh: 但我更务实一些。

segments.en: I know exactly what I want or maybe I saw it.
segments.zh: 我确切地知道我想要什么，或者我看到了它。

segments.en: So I don't want to have to go to the stores and deal with haggling or negotiating or sometimes it's even more expensive.
segments.zh: 所以我不想去商店处理讨价还价或谈判，有时甚至更贵。

segments.en: So I just, from the comfort of my own home, just put in my debit card number and buy things online and I get it delivered overnight.
segments.zh: 所以我只是在自己舒适的家里，输入我的借记卡号码，在网上买东西，第二天就能送到。

segments.en: Well, and you never go shopping now.
segments.zh: 好吧，而你现在都不去购物了。

segments.en: Well, shopping you have to go to the clothing store for clothes, the video game store for video games and on the internet, it's all in one place.
segments.zh: 好吧，买东西的话，衣服得去服装店，电子游戏得去游戏店，而在网上，所有东西都在一处。

segments.en: You're at home, you're in your pajamas, you use your credit card.
segments.zh: 你在家，你穿着睡衣，你使用你的信用卡。

segments.en: And the cool thing is that you can even, sometimes you want to buy small things.
segments.zh: 很酷的是，你甚至可以，有时你想买小东西。

segments.en: Like in this case, maybe a pillow or you want to buy, like recently I bought some candles, some decorative candles.
segments.zh: 就像这种情况下，可能是个枕头，或者你想买的东西，比如我最近买了一些蜡烛，一些装饰用的蜡烛。

segments.en: So I don't know, do you really want to go out downtown, look for the candle shop where you can get them?
segments.zh: 所以我不知道，你真的想去市中心，找可以买到的蜡烛店吗？

segments.en: You can just do it online.
segments.zh: 你可以在网上做。

segments.en: Do it online.
segments.zh: 在线做。

segments.en: Let us know, do you shop on the internet?
segments.zh: 告诉我们，您在网上购物吗？

segments.en: If you do, what kind of services do you use?
segments.zh: 如果你这样做，你使用什么样的服务？

segments.en: What stores do you go to?
segments.zh: 你去哪些商店？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。
